edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender().
constructor passes _msgSender() as the initial owner argument.
constructor calls _setOwner to initialize ownership.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() against the caller-derived _msgSender().
onlyOwner reads the current owner via owner().
owner() reads _owner.
onlyOwner guards the privileged terminate() entry point.
isNotTerminated guards terminate() against repeated execution.
isNotTerminated requires _isTerminated == false.
terminate sets _isTerminated = true.
constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, making deployment timestamp dependent.
releasedBalance derives passedDays from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
terminate recomputes _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
amount in withdraw is derived from releasedBalance() minus _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw performs the subtraction computing amount.
withdraw increments _withdrawedBalance before the transfer.
withdraw performs an external token transfer to the beneficiary.
safeTransfer sends tokens to the _beneficiary address.
transferred amount is bounded by the _withdrawedBalance accounting.
safeTransfer triggers a low-level call into the untrusted token contract.
terminate performs an external token transfer to the owner.
terminate computes amountToWithdraw via subtraction of balance and benefit.
terminate overwrites the mutable _releaseEndTime.
terminate sets _totalBenefit = releasedBalance().
terminate reads _withdrawedBalance for the sweep amount.
safeTransfer triggers a low-level call into the untrusted token contract.
terminate transfers the excess balance to owner().
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance reads _totalBenefit.
releasedBalance does not consult _isTerminated, allowing post-termination accrual semantics.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance().
unreleasedBalance reads _totalBenefit.
withdrawedBalance returns _withdrawedBalance.
token() returns _token.
beneficiary() returns _beneficiary.
totalBenefit() returns _totalBenefit.
withdraw calls releasedBalance() twice for the guard and amount.
withdraw calls token() to perform the safeTransfer.
terminate calls releasedBalance() to shrink _totalBenefit.
terminate calls token() to perform the safeTransfer.
constructor parameter token_ is assigned to _token.
constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to _beneficiary.
constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is rounded down and assigned to _releaseStartTime.
constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ scales the release window.
constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
transferOwnership takes the newOwner parameter.
transferOwnership forwards newOwner to _setOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
oldOwner caches the previous _owner value.
newOwner is written into _owner inside _setOwner.
local amount is the value passed to safeTransfer.
local amount is the result of the subtraction.
local amountToWithdraw is the value passed to safeTransfer.
local amountToWithdraw is the result of the subtraction.
local passedDays is computed inside releasedBalance.
local totalDays is computed inside releasedBalance.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is only used to initialize _token inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is only used to initialize _beneficiary inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is only used to derive _releaseStartTime and _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ is only used to compute _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is only used to initialize _totalBenefit.
newOwner is the sole argument of transferOwnership before being forwarded to _setOwner.
local amount exists only to carry the subtraction result into the withdraw safeTransfer.
local amountToWithdraw exists only to carry the sweep computation into the terminate safeTransfer.
local passedDays is a purely internal intermediate of releasedBalance.
local totalDays is a purely internal intermediate of releasedBalance.
local oldOwner is a purely internal intermediate used only for the OwnershipTransferred event in _setOwner.
